body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/36653

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1129

## What changed

The reported 4096-vs-2048 failure is a ModelOpt NVFP4 packing mismatch in dimension 1, not a TP-sharding mismatch. GLM-5.3's checkpoint-aware resolver retained `modelopt_fp4` for a quantized MTP layer, but `DeepseekModelNextN` then unconditionally discarded that configuration before constructing its decoder.

This moves the legacy DeepSeek ModelOpt-FP4 exception into the base NextN resolver and allows the GLM-5.3 subclass to retain FP4 when the checkpoint does not declare the NextN layer ignored. Checkpoint-declared BF16 GLM NextN layers and legacy DeepSeek FP4 NextN behavior remain unquantized.

I also inspected the open upstream candidate https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37322. That PR covers the same central configuration loss plus broader generic exclusion-prefix remapping. This PR intentionally keeps only the issue-specific correction justified by the prepared checkout.

## Reproduction and tests

Failing before the source change:

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-7bfd059ec3e9/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/models/test_glm5_nextn_quant_config.py
```

The constructed decoder received `quant_config=None` for quantized GLM ModelOpt FP4 weights.

Passing after:

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-7bfd059ec3e9/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/models/test_glm5_nextn_quant_config.py
# 3 passed

/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-7bfd059ec3e9/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/models/test_deepseek_nextn_mm_embed.py test/registered/unit/models/test_glm5_nextn_quant_config.py
# 5 passed
```

The regression covers quantized GLM MTP, checkpoint-declared BF16 GLM MTP, and legacy DeepSeek FP4 MTP boundaries.

## Limitations

The assigned GPU is AMD gfx950. The report requires NVIDIA ModelOpt NVFP4 on two sm_121 nodes, and the 320B checkpoint weights and two-node topology were unavailable. I did not claim a full model load, TP=2 serving reproduction, GPU numerical validation, semantic accuracy, or distributed qualification. The result is reported as `candidate_verified`; complete evidence and commands are under `reports/j-7bfd059ec3e9/`.
